avis.texte: My skin is sensitive to both the sun and traditional chemical-based sunscreens so I have to use the mineral-base ones. This is the best one I have tried. The SPF 30 still protects me well and rubs in a lot better than the SPF 50. It will still leave a white layer on your skin and I have seen some 1 star reviews because of it. However, that is how mineral-based screens work - they create a layer that reflects UV rather than absorbing UV into your skin and causing a chemical reaction in/under the skin. I do wish there was one that could fully be absorbed and not visible but... physics.

avis.titre: Highly effective and it doesn't make your eyes burn
avis.texte: This "mineral" sunscreen combines both zinc and titanium oxides in a smooth base that goes on easily, protects very well, and doesn't burn your eyes. It is also free from the organic chemicals that are banned in Hawaii and other places for damaging corals. I wore it every day for a week, being outside most of the day, and had no sunburn at all, not even mild redness. It didn't come off when I perspired and did not bother my eyes so I could use it freely on my forehead. The only downside is that it is not entirely clear and it gives one a slightly "clownish" appearance. It is certainly not as noticeable as the zinc oxide creams that lifeguards typically wear on their noses. I will purchase it again and use it exclusively.

avis.titre: READ THIS REVIEW BEFORE PURCHASING THIS!
avis.texte: I bought this sunscreen only because we were going to St Croix and they require a mineral sunscreen on the island. I definitely will not be buying it again though. As soon as we applied, we noticed a very prominent white casting. My husband and I looked like we got blasted with powder. I was thinking even though we both look ridiculous, at least our skin is protected. Well, it is NOT waterproof or water resistant. As soon as we got in any water (ocean or pool), it was no longer on us (not protecting our skin). I received a horrible sunburn on our 2nd day of our 7-day vacation. I was miserable for about 4 days. I regret purchasing this sunscreen. I always read the reviews of anything I purchase and most of the reviews were good so that’s why I purchased THIS particular EXPENSIVE sunscreen. Therefore I wanted to post a REAL review to inform people of what they are purchasing before they spend their money on it. -Leaves a very prominent white casting. -Is NOT water resistant or waterproof. If you plan to get in any water, you will NOT be protected from the sun until you get out of the water and reapply.

avis.titre: Needed for a trip to Maui - only mineral sunscreens are allowed
avis.texte: One of the more reasonably priced options. It’s a mineral sunscreen. Don’t dab it all over and expect to double back and spread it out. Doesn’t work that way. Get it on and spread it as quickly as possible. It turns into a dried on film fairly quickly so you’re in a race. Works as advertised. Lasts all day, even when in the water. Leaves a bit of a white sheen sorta. Kinda actually gives a purplish tone on Caucasian skin. It’s not purple by any means. It’s kinda funny seeing all kinds of people all walking around with their purpley (is that a word?) self. Getting it off in the shower is an experience too.

Great sunscreen for people will sensitive skin! This is one of the very few sunscreens that does not cause my face to break out. The bottle arrived super quickly and was actually bigger than expected! The only reason this did not get 5 stars from me is because applying the product it was so thick, the sunscreen never really disappeared, it left a white tint to the skin even if you continued and continued to rub it in, at least it was protective! A positive for this sunscreen is that a little did go along way, hopefully it will last me awhile then!

avis.titre: Great sunscreen, will definitely buy again.
avis.texte: Great sunscreen. Was easy to put on. The whiteness of the zinc did not show up on my white skin, but my son who has darker skin, the zinc did show up on his skin. But that's ok, we did not want to get burned when we went hiking. Smells ok, smells like sunscreen, but a light smell.But, it did not feel heavy or greasy on my skin, which was a plus.

This is my third try as a CeraVe mineral sunscreen and I can't say I'm a fan. It's not that it doesn't work for the advertised purpose of meeting SPF 30, I'm confident that it provides sun protection, but it has some unfortunate characteristics: - Only zinc provides a high degree of UVA protection relative to titanium dioxide, and the zinc content is very low, 5%. Other SPF 30 products contain 15%-20%. It's neither water-resistant for sport use nor a highly-effective choice for daily UVA anti-aging protection, which makes me wonder what it's really for. - Bizarrely, this is one of four CeraVe mineral sunscreen products I've tried over a few years that refuses to dry to a stable film. It's on towels, shirt sleeves, the interior of my car. There's a stubborn forehead print on my yoga mat from the face version and I had to scrub handprints off the bench at the gym yesterday. This might be worsened by mild summer sweating, but it's seemingly a trait of their overall formulation strategy. - Despite containing very little zinc, it goes on oddly thick and white. There's very little I can do to rub it in enough to stop leaving visible swirls around my arm hair and my arms look ghostly. There are competing mineral products that deliver a decent finish and also have high percentages of zinc. Three stars because despite the weirdness I do think it's effective and reasonably priced, washes off decently, and smells fine.

Cumple su función como protector solar pero no me gustó el olor ligero que tiene.
Es realmente hidratante pero deja esta película blancosa que desaparece con el tiempo pero igual nunca deja de verse y definitivamente no es para pieles morenas

avis.titre: Excellent mineral sunscreen - no irritation or sunburn
avis.texte: If you’re looking for a mineral sunscreen, this one by CeraVe is a good buy for the price and performance. Although this sunscreen didn’t absorb well (“mineral” sunscreens usually don’t), this sunscreen was hydrating and non-irritating, and I got sufficient sun protection for 2 hours. For the price, you’re getting a good sunscreen and I recommend this one over other mineral sunscreens. In particular, this sunscreen uses 6% titanium dioxide and 5% zinc oxide as its active ingredients to get to SPF 30 protection. It’s intended for “body” sunscreen, but you can also use it on your face. Given that it’s a “mineral” sunscreen (i.e. physical UV blocking ingredients), it didn’t really absorb into my skin at all, but it at least distributed better than other mineral sunscreens I’ve tried. There's no fragrance/scent with this sunscreen, which I liked. It didn’t dehydrate my skin or irritate it at all. In fact, my skin probably felt more hydrated when I wore it. I went for a hike in the sun for 2 hours and didn’t get burnt, nor did my skin get warm from early burning.

avis.titre: Rub in well, until white cast is no longer visible.
avis.texte: When I first applied this sunscreen to my skin, I was concerned that it would show visible white residue. The consistency of this is very thick, so it does take a bit of effort to spread it over skin. As long as I take the time to rub this in until it absorbs, it does not leave behind visible white streaks. I use this on my face and my body. This has a hydrating formula that soothes and calms my eczema. It is lightweight and does not clog my pores. I like using this on my face because, unlike other sunscreens, it does not irritate my sensitive eyes.

avis.titre: Received with an expiration date only a month away.
avis.texte: I have never left a review before but I was really disappointed that I received a bottle on 2/8/21 with an expiration date of 3/21... Yeah I'm going to try to get my money back. I recommend just going to the store if it is safe to do so.

avis.titre: Effective, Hydrating Sunscreen; Gentle on Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I normally use a spray-on sunscreen that goes on clear, but it's not always easy to tell if I have full coverage, and the coverage doesn't tend to last very long. I'm very pale and I burn quickly, so I need a reliable sunscreen if I'm planning to be out in the open sun for any length of time. My skin is also sensitive and dry. This CeraVe Hydrating Sunscreen addresses all of these issues -- the white cream makes it easier to tell if I've covered all exposed skin, the hydrating formula means I don't have to use a separate lotion, and the gentle, noncomedogenic ingredients don't irritate my skin. As other reviewers have noted, this CeraVe sunscreen does leave a white cast. The tube even had an attached informational sheet (see photos) that addressed this point. But since my skin is naturally very pale, the white cast isn't as noticeable on me. And I'd far prefer my ghostly pallor to a damaging burn! I also like that this sunscreen is oil-free and paraben-free. Those with scent sensitivities will appreciate that it is fragrance-free, as well. Overall, I'm very happy with this CeraVe Hydrating Sunscreen. I'll probably stick with my usual spray-on sunscreen for more limited sun exposure, but I'll be using this when I need extra protection -- such as when I'm biking, attending outdoor concerts, or out on the water. This is a great choice for anyone with sensitive, dry, and/or sunburn-prone skin!

avis.titre: Great Sun Protection With Zinc Oxide & Titanium Dioxide - Yet Gentle On MY Skin
avis.texte: This stays on the skin, giving it a white appearance. I love this type of sun protection. The directions that come with this explicitly tell you how to apply it so that you have only the faintest glow, and not the bright white appearance I had the first time I used it. This gives me GREAT protection -- I love zinc oxide against the harmful rays of the sun -- especially on my nose. This provides broad spectrum UV protection, reflecting both UVA/UVB rays. It is oxybenzone free, oil free, paraben free, fragrance free, chemical-filter free. This has been gentle on my skin -- no problems using it at all.

avis.titre: It has a very orange undertones. Regret buying
avis.texte: I got the Light shade. I would say I’m pretty pale but also not that pale? Idk I didn’t like how oily it was, I wanted it to be sheer but this is just oily. It dosnt look or feel good on anyone I tested it on with dry skin. I have combination skin and it did awful and made me breakout the next day it transfers on the skin, I tested it on the back of my hand to really see how it looked in real lights. 0/10. ORANGE. If you have already red/pink undertones do NOT buy this it will not look good in the sunlight. In my bedroom I thought it looked good but my room has yellowish light so I looked in my bathroom & in sunlight both times you could see it was not a match and orangey. Maybe if it did match it would look better? But I bet it’s still has the orange undertone. I will say the sunscreen worked I was in a area that was 1/2 sunny 1/2 shady. I didn’t burn at all. Usually my face burns easy but it didn’t. It got a lil tan. I really hoped this would work since it’s affordable but unfortunately no.
